name: Yarasero ~Fujiwara Saori no Baai~
original_name: 犯らせろ ～藤原沙織の場合～
source:
Main character can't take his eyes from Saori Fujiwara. He wants to make shameful pictures of her and then blackmail her into a relationship.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-october-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角的目光无法从藤原纱织身上移开。他想给她拍一些可耻的照片，然后勒索她建立关系。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-october-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
